approval_note: Approved by the maintainer unchanged: lr in {0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0} x feature_power in {0, 0.5, 1}, seeds 100/101, 30 runs. The Gaussian-input step-multiplier computation that motivated the choice of powers was preliminary evidence only and says nothing proven about MNIST; the grid is changed only after a separately approved investigation of real MNIST validation results.

selection.rule: candidates within 0.005 of the maximum mean final accuracy; among them the lowest mean forgetting; exact ties: higher accuracy, then grid order
selection.split: protocol.validation (holdout_fraction 0.1, holdout_seed 123 of the training data)
